trends.name: Middle East Ceasefire Collapse Risk
trends.summary: Israeli officials express low confidence in Lebanon negotiations despite talks scheduled at State Department. Iran demanding ceasefire compliance on all fronts including Lebanon, with US-Iran in-person peace talks Saturday in Pakistan with high-level delegations (JD Vance, Kushner, Araghchi). Netanyahu allegedly conducting attacks undermining Trump ceasefire, creating acute geopolitical instability.

trends.name: Oil Surge on Hormuz Disruption
trends.summary: WTI crude nearing $103/barrel (+12% in 24 hours, +$1/hour pace) as Iran asserts control over Strait of Hormuz and demands crypto tolls. Only ~15 vessels/day transiting vs. normal 135/day; ~55% probability traffic normalizes before July 1. Critical chokepoint blockage threatening global energy prices and shipping.

trends.name: US Economic Growth Collapse
trends.summary: Q4 2025 GDP growth crashed to 0.5% from Q3's 4.4%, far below expectations. Personal incomes saw rare decline with real incomes at weakest since Dec 2022. Core PCE inflation remains elevated despite supercore easing. Macro slowdown signals potential recession risk amid geopolitical uncertainty.

trends.name: AI Infrastructure Spending Race
trends.summary: Meta committing additional $21 billion to CoreWeave as AI capex acceleration continues despite margin pressures. Amazon CEO Jassy defends $200 billion AI spend with aggressive strategy. Nebius positioned as constant AI infrastructure changer. Tech giants locked in trillion-dollar AI buildout competition driving semiconductor and cloud demand.

trends.name: Income Inequality & Wage Divergence
trends.summary: Wage growth among higher-income US households now outpacing lower-earning cohorts by widest margin in over a decade. Indicates consumer spending resilience concentrated in wealthy segments while broader household purchasing power weakens amid inflation.

trends.name: Intel Foundry Turnaround Materializing
trends.summary: Intel Foundry Services emerging as potential turnaround catalyst this decade, positioning Intel for competitive chipmaking recovery. Critical for US semiconductor sovereignty amid China tensions and AI infrastructure buildout.

trends.name: Corporate Layoffs & Cost Cutting
trends.summary: Disney planning up to 1,000 employee layoffs signaling broader cost-cutting amid slowing growth. Endava struggling with AI pivot pressuring margins. Reflects corporate margin defense strategies in uncertain economic environment.

trends.name: Trump Geopolitical Realignment
trends.summary: Trump administration planning NATO troop repositioning—moving out of 'unhelpful' countries and stationing in 'supportive' nations. Military readiness maintained near Iran pending 'real agreement.' Signals major shift in US military strategy and alliance structure with broad market implications.

trends.name: Dividend Growth & Consumer Stocks
trends.summary: VYMI flagged for global dividend growth; Costco shares rising on impressive monthly sales; Revolve Group delivering solid GARP growth. Consumer discretionary and dividend payers attracting investor interest amid macro uncertainty as yield-seeking behavior persists.

trends.name: Nuclear Energy Renaissance
trends.summary: New Jersey Governor Sherrill lifts 40-year nuclear moratorium, accelerating clean energy transition and addressing data center power demands. Signals major policy shift supporting nuclear for AI infrastructure and decarbonization goals.

trends.name: Data Center Regulation & Real Estate
trends.summary: Maine becomes first state with data center ban, creating regulatory headwinds for AI/cloud infrastructure buildout. Contrasts with New Jersey nuclear expansion, indicating fragmented state-level policies constraining data center locations and energy supply.

trends.name: Pharma M&A & GLP-1 Market Dynamics
trends.summary: GLP-1 weight-loss drug cost comparisons (Wegovy, Zepbound, Foundayo) dominating consumer health discourse. AbbVie positioned as buy ahead of Q1 earnings; Genmab faces multiple binaries. GLP-1 market structurally reshaping pharma valuations and treatment paradigms.
